findings.source_finding: anchor / succession一意性がcaller-controlledなlineage_id内に限定され、同じ凍結source / targetを別lineageとして再登録できる。凍結source値も機械定数ではない。
findings.threat: A caller changes lineage_id or mutable frozen-source input and registers the same source or target as a new recovery.
invariants: The verifier derives the recovery key from repository ID, terminal manifest digest, canonical source and target, and protocol major.
The frozen source coordinates are machine constants from the terminal manifest, not caller inputs.
The complete repository program inventory contains at most one recovery for the canonical source and target.
negative_examples: Reject the same source and target under a different lineage_id.
Reject a caller-supplied source SHA that differs from the terminal manifest.
findings.required_runtime_proof: A complete-inventory uniqueness trace keyed outside caller control.

findings.source_finding: trusted verifier receiptの真正性、receipt digest導出、repository / audience、lineage全inventoryでのapproval / authorization ID・nonce・run replayがaggregate検証されない。
findings.threat: A caller forges a verified flag, replays a valid receipt in another repository or audience, or reuses an approval, authorization, nonce, run, or jti.
invariants: Verify the OIDC signature, issuer, audience, subject, repository ID, workflow and ref, environment, run tuple, jti, and expiry.
Derive and verify the receipt digest from the authenticated claims and bound program inputs.
Reject approval ID, authorization ID, nonce, run tuple, and jti reuse across the complete lineage inventory.
negative_examples: Reject caller-supplied verified=true without authenticated claims.
Reject a valid receipt replayed under another repository, audience, or lineage.
findings.required_runtime_proof: A trusted receipt verification trace plus complete lineage-global replay inventory.

findings.source_finding: approval、Owner authorization、progression、attempt、fencing generation / token、barrier、projectionの完全joinとlatest / active状態が不足し、別head・失効済み状態のspliceを閉じていない。
findings.threat: An attacker splices approval or authority from another head or uses a stale fence, barrier, attempt, or projection to publish success.
invariants: Join anchor, approval, Owner authorization, progression, attempt, fencing generation and token, exact barrier inventory, and projection on the same program and target.
Every joined record is the latest active non-revoked record at the success decision.
The read-only verifier cannot create or update the success projection.
negative_examples: Reject an approval from another head with an otherwise valid attempt.
Reject an expired fence generation or barrier inventory missing one writer.
findings.required_runtime_proof: A full latest-active cross-record join and independent publisher trace.

findings.source_finding: 1 round最大3 attempt、1 lineage最大15 attemptは定数確認だけで、aggregate validatorが4件目 / 16件目を拒否しない。
findings.threat: Concurrent or replayed reservations exceed the per-round or per-lineage attempt ceiling, or restart a terminal lineage.
invariants: Atomically reserve and reject the fourth attempt in one round.
Atomically reserve and reject the sixteenth attempt in one lineage.
Reject concurrent over-reservation and every attempt after a terminal lineage state.
negative_examples: Reject two concurrent reservations that would create attempts three and four from the same prior count.
Reject attempt sixteen even when it starts a new round in the same lineage.
findings.required_runtime_proof: An aggregate reservation trace proving the 3-per-round and 15-per-lineage limits.

findings.source_finding: mainだけが移動した場合に同じprogressionをfresh receiptで再試行する文書経路と、progression / attemptのapproval・Owner digest不変条件が両立しない。
findings.threat: A main-only change either makes the valid state machine unreachable or permits stale approval and Owner authorization to survive into a new attempt.
invariants: A main-only movement keeps the same head-bound progression but requires a new attempt authorization bound to fresh main, approval, and Owner authorization.
A head movement invalidates the current progression and requires the next permitted round rather than a main-refresh attempt.
The progression and attempt digests distinguish immutable head state from refreshable main-bound authority.
negative_examples: Reject reuse of the prior main approval after main moves.
Reject treating a head change as a main-only refresh.
findings.required_runtime_proof: Reachable main-only and head-change transition traces with fresh authority binding.

findings.source_finding: successに必要なpagination完全性、Check identity一意性、GitHub側atomic main freshness、rollback invalidator generationの証跡が完全traceのtrusted inputとして検証されない。
findings.threat: A partial inventory, duplicate Check, stale main comparison, active writer, or failed rollback is omitted from a success decision.
invariants: Prove every pagination cursor, hasNextPage=false, no duplicate or missing record, and one expected Check identity.
Use GitHub-enforced merge queue or strict up-to-date protection for atomic main freshness instead of a custom last-second comparison.
After writer fencing, prove drain and quiescence with double readback and a generation increase.
Project rollback failure and verify the final invalidator generation by readback.
negative_examples: Reject an inventory that omits a final page or contains two matching Checks.
Reject success when a writer remains active or rollback readback is missing.
findings.required_runtime_proof: A complete pagination, atomic freshness, fencing, quiescence, projection, and rollback trace.
